entities.summary: Brett Bulmer is a Canadian professional ice hockey player. He is currently playing for Indy Fuel in the ECHL. Bulmer previously iced with the Nottingham Panthers and the Fife Flyers in the EIHL. He was selected by the Minnesota Wild in the second round of the 2010 NHL Entry Draft.
